source_text: Περὶ μὲν οὖν σωφροσύνης τοσοῦτον εἶπεν· ,,Ὅς ἂν ἐμβλέψῃ γυναικὶ πρὸς τὸ ἐπιθυμῆσαι αὐτῆς, ἤδη ἐμοίχευσε τῇ καρδίᾳ παρὰ τῷ θεῷ“. Καί· ,,Εἰ ὁ ὀφθαλμός σου ὁ δεξιὸς σκανδαλίζει σε, ἔκκοψον αὐτόν· συμφέρει γάρ σοι μονόφθαλμον εἰσελθεῖν εἰς τὴν βασιλείαν τῶν οὐρανῶν, ἢ μετὰ τῶν δύο πεμφθῆναι εἰς τὸ αἰώνιον πῦρ“. Καί· ,,Ὃς γαμεῖ ἀπολελυμένην ἀφ᾿ ἑτέρου ἀνδρός, μοιχᾶται“. Καί· ,,Εἰσί τινες οἵτινες εὐνουχίσθησαν ὑπὸ τῶν ἀνθρώπων, εἰσὶ δὲ οἵ ἐγεννήθησαν εὐνοῦχοι, εἰσὶ δὲ οἵ εὐνούχισαν ἑαυτοὺς διὰ τὴν βασιλείαν τῶν οὐρανῶν· πλήν οὐ πάντες τοῦτο χωροῦσιν“. Ὥσπερ καὶ οἱ νόμῳ ἀνθρωπίνῳ διγαμίας ποιούμενοι ἁμαρτωλοὶ παρὰ τῷ· ἡμετέρῳ διδασκάλῳ εἰσί, καὶ οἱ προσβλέποντες γυναικὶ πρὸς τὸ ἐπιθυμῆσαι αὐτῆς· οὐ γὰρ μόνον ὁ μοιχεύων ἔργῳ ἐκβέβληται παρ᾿ αὐτῷ, ἀλλὰ καὶ ὁ μοιχεῦσαι βουλόμενος, ὡς οὐ τῶν ἔργων φανερῶν μόνον τῷ θεῷ ἀλλὰ καὶ τῶν ἐνθυμημάτων. Καὶ πολλοί τινες καὶ πολλαὶ ἑξηκοντοῦται καὶ ἑβδομηκοντοῦται, οἵ ἐκ παίδων ἐμαθητεύθησαν τῷ Χριστῷ, ἄφθοροι διαμένουσι· καὶ εὔχομαι κατὰ πᾶν γένος ἀνθρώπων τοιούτους δεῖξαι. Τί γὰρ καὶ λέγομεν τὸ ἀναρίθμητον πλῆθος τῶν ἐξ ἀκολασίας μεταβαλόντων καὶ ταῦτα μαθόντων; οὐ γὰρ τοὺς δικαίους οὐδὲ τοὺς σώφρονας εἰς μετάνοιαν ἐκάλεσεν ὁ Χριστός, ἀλλὰ τοὺς ἀσεβεῖς καὶ ἀκολάστους καὶ ἀδίκους. Εἶπε δὲ οὕτως· ,,Οὐκ ἦλθον καλέσαι δικαίους, ἀλλὰ ἁμαρτωλοὺς εἰς μετάνοιαν“. Θέλει γὰρ ὁ πατὴρ ὁ οὐράνιος τὴν μετάνοιαν τοῦ ἁμαρτωλοῦ ἢ τὴν κόλασιν αὐτοῦ. Περὶ δὲ τοῦ στέργειν ἅπαντας ταῦτα ἐδίδαξεν· ,,Εἰ ἀγαπᾶτε τοὺς ἀγαπῶντας ὑμᾶς, τί καινὸν ποιεῖτε; καὶ γὰρ οἱ πόρνοι τοῦτο ποιοῦσιν. Ἐγὼ δὲ ὑμῖν λέγω· Εὔχεσθε ὑπὲρ τῶν ἐχθρῶν ὑμῶν καὶ ἀγαπᾶτε τοὺς μισοῦντας ὑμᾶς καὶ εὐλογεῖτε τοὺς καταρωμένους ὑμῖν καὶ εὔχεσθε ὑπὲρ τῶν ἐπηρεαζόντων ὑμᾶς“. Εἰς δὲ τὸ κοινωνεῖν τοῖς δεομένοις καὶ μηδὲν πρὸς δόξαν ποιεῖν ταῦτα ἔφη· ,,Παντὶ τῷ αἰτοῦντι δίδοτε καὶ τὸν βουλόμενον δανείσασθαι μὴ ἀποστραφῆτε. Εἰ γὰρ δανείζετε παρ᾿ ὧν ἐλπίζετε λαβεῖν, τί καινὸν ποιεῖτε; τοῦτο καὶ οἱ τελῶναι ποιοῦσιν. Ὑμεῖς δὲ μὴ θησαυρίζητε ἑαυτοῖς ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς, ὅπου σὴς καὶ βρῶσις ἀφανίζει καὶ λῃσταὶ διορύσσουσι· θησαυρίζετε δὲ ἑαυτοῖς ἐν τοῖς οὐρανοῖς, ὅπου οὔτε σὴς οὔτε βρῶσις ἀφανίζει. Τί γὰρ ὠφελεῖται ἄνθρωπος, ἂν τὸν κόσμον ὅλον κερδήσῃ, τὴν δὲ ψυχὴν αὐτοῦ ἀπολέσῃ; ἢ τί δώσει αὐτῆς ἀντάλλαγμα; θησαυρίζετε οὖν ἐν τοῖς οὐρανοῖς, ὅπου οὔτε σὴς οὔτε βρῶσις ἀφανίζει“. Καί· ,,Γίνεσθε δὲ χρηστοὶ καὶ οἰκτίρμονες, ὡς καὶ ὁ πατὴρ ὑμῶν χρηστός ἐστι καὶ οἰκτίρμων, καὶ τὸν ἥλιον αὐτοῦ ἀνατέλλει ἐπὶ ἁμαρτωλοὺς καὶ δικαίους καὶ πονηρούς. Μὴ μεριμνᾶτε δὲ τί φάγητε ἢ τί ἐνδύσησθε. Οὐχ ὑμεῖς τῶν πετεινῶν καὶ τῶν θηρίων διαφέρετε; καὶ ὁ θεὸς τρέφει αὐτά. Μὴ οὖν μεριμνήσητε τί φάγητε ἢ τί ἐνδύσησθε· οἶδε γὰρ ὁ πατὴρ ὑμῶν ὁ οὐράνιος ὅτι τούτων χρείαν ἔχετε. Ζητεῖτε δὲ τὴν βασιλείαν τῶν οὐρανῶν, καὶ ταῦτα πάντα προστεθήσεται ὑμῖν. Ὅπου γὰρ ὁ θησαυρός ἐστιν, ἐκεῖ καὶ ὁ νοῦς τοῦ ἀνθρώπου“. Καί· ,,Μὴ ποιῆτε ταῦτα πρὸς τὸ θεαθῆναι ὑπὸ τῶν ἀνθρώπων· εἰ δὲ μή γε, μισθὸν οὐκ ἔχετε παρὰ τοῦ πατρὸς ὑμῶν τοῦ ἐν τοῖς οὐρανοῖς“.
pass_a_gloss: He spoke thus about self-control: 'Whoever looks at a woman to desire her has already committed adultery with her in his heart before God.' And: 'If your right eye causes you to sin, cut it out; for it is better for you to enter the kingdom of heaven with one eye than to be thrown into eternal fire with two.' And: 'Whoever marries a woman divorced from another man commits adultery.' And: 'There are some who have been castrated by men, there are some who were born eunuchs, and there are some who have castrated themselves for the kingdom of heaven; but not all can accept this.' Just as those who remarry according to human law are sinners before our Teacher, so also are those who look at a woman to desire her; for not only is the one who commits adultery in deed cast out by Him, but also the one who wishes to commit adultery, as God is not only aware of visible deeds but also of thoughts. And many men and women, sixty and seventy years old, who were disciples of Christ from childhood, remain pure; and I pray that such people may be shown in every kind of human. For what can we say about the countless number of people who have changed from a life of licentiousness and learned these things? For Christ did not call the righteous or the self-controlled to repentance, but the ungodly and the licentious and the unrighteous. He said: 'I did not come to call the righteous, but sinners to repentance.' For the heavenly Father wants the repentance of the sinner rather than his punishment. Now He taught these things about loving all: 'If you love those who love you, what are you doing that is new? Even the prostitutes do this.' But I say to you: 'Pray for your enemies and love those who hate you and bless those who curse you and pray for those who mistreat you.' And to share with those in need and not do these things for glory, He said: 'Give to everyone who asks you, and do not turn away from anyone who wants to borrow from you. For if you lend to those from whom you expect to receive, what are you doing that is new? This is what the tax collectors do. Do not treasure up for yourselves on earth, where moth and rust destroy and thieves break in; but treasure up for yourselves in heaven, where neither moth nor rust destroys. For what does it profit a person to gain the whole world but lose his own soul? Or what will he give in exchange for it? Therefore, treasure up for yourselves in heaven, where neither moth nor rust destroys.' And: 'Be kind and merciful, just as your Father is kind and merciful, and He makes His sun rise. Do not worry about what you will eat or what you will wear. Are you not different from the birds and the beasts? And God feeds them. Therefore, do not worry about what you will eat or what you will wear; for your heavenly Father knows that you need these things. Seek the kingdom of heaven, and all these things will be added to you. For where your treasure is, there your mind will be.' And: 'Do not do these things to be seen by men; for if you do, you will have no reward from your Father in heaven.'

pass_b_english: He said this much about self-control: "Whoever looks at a woman to desire her has already committed adultery with her in his heart before God" (Matthew 5:27-28). And: "If your right eye causes you to sin, cut it out; for it is better for you to enter the kingdom of heaven with one eye than to be thrown into eternal fire with two" (Matthew 5:29-30). And: "Whoever marries a woman divorced from another man commits adultery" (Matthew 5:31-32). And: "There are some who have been castrated by men, there are some who were born eunuchs, and there are some who have castrated themselves for the sake of the kingdom of heaven; but not all can accept this" (Matthew 19:12). Just as those who remarry according to human law are sinners before our Teacher, so also are those who look at a woman to desire her; for not only is the one who commits adultery in deed cast out by Him, but also the one who wishes to commit adultery, as God is not only aware of visible deeds but also of thoughts. And many men and women, sixty and seventy years old, who were disciples of Christ from childhood, remain pure; and I pray that such people may be shown in every kind of human. For what can we say about the countless number of people who have changed from a life of licentiousness and learned these things? For Christ did not call the righteous or the self-controlled to repentance, but the ungodly and the licentious and the unrighteous. He said: "I did not come to call the righteous, but sinners to repentance" (Matthew 9:13). For the heavenly Father wants the repentance of the sinner rather than his punishment.

Now He taught these things about loving all: "If you love those who love you, what are you doing that is new? Even the prostitutes do this." But I say to you: "Pray for your enemies and love those who hate you and bless those who curse you and pray for those who mistreat you" (Matthew 5:44-45). And to share with those in need and not do these things for glory, He said: "Give to everyone who asks you, and do not turn away from anyone who wants to borrow from you. For if you lend to those from whom you expect to receive, what are you doing that is new? This is what the tax collectors do. Do not treasure up for yourselves on earth, where moth and rust destroy and thieves break in; but treasure up for yourselves in heaven, where neither moth nor rust destroys. For what does it profit a person to gain the whole world but lose his own soul? Or what will he give in exchange for it? Therefore, treasure up for yourselves in heaven, where neither moth nor rust destroys" (Matthew 6:19-20). And: "Be kind and merciful, just as your Father is kind and merciful, and He makes His sun rise on sinners and the righteous and the wicked. Do not worry about what you will eat or what you will wear. Are you not different from the birds and the beasts? And God feeds them. Therefore, do not worry about what you will eat or what you will wear; for your heavenly Father knows that you need these things. Seek the kingdom of heaven, and all these things will be added to you. For where your treasure is, there your mind will be" (Matthew 6:25-26; Matthew 6:21). And: "Do not do these things to be seen by men; for if you do, you will have no reward from your Father in heaven" (Matthew 6:1).
